# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services | Micro: CPA tax firm

| Universal method | [step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md](../../../../00_universal-framework/projects/step-05_P03_regulatory-gap-analysis/README.md) |
| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** FTC Safeguards Rule, 16 CFR Part 314
**Why:** It is the only broad, binding written-security-program rule that reaches the largest group of small professional firms (every tax-preparing CPA or accounting practice). Its nine prescriptive elements (314.4(a)-(i)) make clear, auditable gap criteria with a built-in small-firm carve-out (314.6). For DoD contractors, use NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 instead. For law firms, pair it with state-adopted ABA Rule 1.6(c).
